mechanistic_finding: StopGrad-Key's contribution operates almost entirely through improving cross-candidate complementarity (C), not individual relevance (D). delta_C_SG (C_J1 - C_OriginalKL) is essentially zero at H96 (-0.0006) but large and negative (-0.0854, i.e. J1's C is much better) at H720 -- exactly matching the horizon pattern in the downstream Stage2 gain. This reproduces and extends TRACK-J3's original D/C decomposition finding.

hypothesis_verdicts.H_A_future_aligned_KL_is_main: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED at H96 (G_KL=52%, largest single component there) but NOT at H720 (G_KL=29%, smaller than G_SG)
hypothesis_verdicts.H_B_stopgrad_key_also_core: STRONGLY SUPPORTED at H720 (G_SG=50%, the single largest component, highly significant) but NOT SUPPORTED at H96 (G_SG~0, not significant)
hypothesis_verdicts.H_C_multislot_long_horizon_only: SUPPORTED so far (H96: G_MS significantly NEGATIVE; H720: G_MS significantly POSITIVE, 9% of total) -- consistent with only 2 horizons, needs H192/H336 to confirm a genuine trend vs. a two-point artifact
hypothesis_verdicts.H_D_M2_wins_everywhere: NOT SUPPORTED -- M2 loses to J1 at H96 (significant)

case_assessment: No single PART 22 Case (1-4) cleanly fits both horizons simultaneously. H96 alone matches a Case-1-like pattern (Cosine->OriginalKL is the whole story; StopGrad-Key and Multi-Slot add nothing or hurt). H720 alone matches a Case-2/3 blend (StopGrad-Key is the single largest contributor, AND Multi-Slot adds a smaller but real, significant further gain on top). The honest reading with only 2 of 4 horizons and 1 seed is that contribution is HORIZON-DEPENDENT, not yet a settled single verdict -- H192/H336 and seed1/2 are needed before committing to one Case.
